description.zh: 分页大小。取值范围：10-100。默认为50。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.
The region ID. Set the value to cn-hangzhou.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos list-applications --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 10 --next-token - --tags k1=v1 k2=v2 --names MyApplication --name MyApplications --application-type DingTalk --region cn-hangzhou
